## Research

**Real-Time Threat Detection System for Campus Security Using Integrated Computer Vision Techniques**

Chapter in Integrated Technologies in Electrical, Electronics and Biotechnology Engineering — CRC Press, 2025 (ICITEEB 2025 proceedings)

A real-time campus security system that combines face recognition, weapon detection and gesture and posture analysis, with local and email alerts. Built as Garun Drishti.

Link: https://www.routledge.com/Integrated-Technologies-in-Electrical-Electronics-and-Biotechnology-Engineering-Volume-1/Aggarwal-Shukla-EweanDavidson-Bansal/p/book/9781041318422

## Quick answers

### Who is Harsh Sinha?

Harsh Sinha is a technology founder and software engineer. He is the Founder & CEO of Geek Hoppers and is also known as The Geek Harsh.

### What is Geek Hoppers?

Geek Hoppers is a technology company founded in January 2026. It designs and develops websites, web applications, AI workflows, data products and enterprise Adobe Experience Manager solutions for startups, growing teams and enterprises.

### What services does Geek Hoppers offer?

Websites and web applications, AI and machine learning, data science and analytics, and Adobe Experience Manager.

### What is The Geek Harsh?

The Geek Harsh is Harsh Sinha's personal technology and founder platform, hosted at thegeekharsh.in.

### What does Harsh Sinha work with as an engineer?

Adobe Experience Manager, APIs, content migration, cloud platforms and performance; Java, Spring Boot, Python, JavaScript, databases and system design; and machine learning, deep learning, OpenCV, YOLO, MediaPipe and computer vision.

### What is Harsh Sinha’s research?

He published the chapter "Real-Time Threat Detection System for Campus Security Using Integrated Computer Vision Techniques" in Integrated Technologies in Electrical, Electronics and Biotechnology Engineering (CRC Press, 2025, ICITEEB 2025 proceedings). It describes a real-time campus security system, built as Garun Drishti, that combines face recognition, weapon detection and gesture and posture analysis, with local and email alerts.

### What is Harsh Sinha’s background?

He holds a B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering from IMS Engineering College (2021–2025), was a Summer Trainee in Advanced Java at Softpro Technologies in 2024, worked as a Software Developer on enterprise Adobe Experience Manager, and has been Founder & CEO of Geek Hoppers since 2026.

### How can I contact Harsh Sinha?

For projects, email hello@thegeekharsh.in or visit geekhoppers.com. For speaking, media and collaboration, email media@thegeekharsh.in. He is also on LinkedIn at linkedin.com/in/harshsinhaa.
